summary: RAITProvisioningEditAll is a UserControl in the HSPnet enrollment module, intended to administer and edit RAIT Provisioning records for students across entire cohorts, allowing mass update, addition, and review. It provides both single and bulk editing workflows, supports filtering and validation, and is tightly integrated into the broader Enrollment system UI.
purpose: To allow administrative users to view, edit, add, and manage RAIT Provisioning records for multiple students in a cohort, including mass editing and single record maintenance, while enforcing necessary validations, business rules, and system behaviors typical of enrollment provisioning actions.

workflows.name: Mass Edit and Save RAIT Provisionings
steps: User enters edit mode (single or all) for RAIT Provisionings
Grid rows are populated with related StudentRAITProvisioning records
User edits desired fields (agency, unique ID, login ID, email, etc.)
Dirty flag is tracked per row for updates
On Save All or Save Edit Next, iterate rows:
If row is dirty, update or add StudentRAITProvisioning via StudentRAITProvisionings
If no errors, redirect to Enrollment screen or Edit Next set
If errors, stay on current screen and display messages

workflows.name: Single Record Edit
steps: User enters edit mode for a single record
Fields are loaded for the StudentRAITProvisioning
On Save, update or add StudentRAITProvisioning via object methods
If no errors, redirect; else, display errors

workflows.name: Grid UI Filtering and Sorting
steps: Apply filters and sorts via SectionFilter, ActionFilter, etc.
Support paged data view via StartRow, PageSize

business_rules: Records can only be edited if not in read-only mode (blnReadOnly=false)
Only dirty rows (changed fields) are candidates for update/add
If EnrollmentID is non-zero (editing single), hide mass edit controls
Each save triggers validation via UserSession.Messages
Agency selection must be made for each row
EmailRequired and Employee status must be set appropriately
UniqueID and LoginID are required for new records
validations: ValidationSummary UI control used for displaying errors
UserSession.Messages.GetErrors() determines if operation can redirect
Value presence checks for UniqueID, LoginID, Agency
Data binding events validate user session existence
calculations: Grid row dirty flag computed for mass edits
Query string parameters constructed dynamically for redirects
conditions: If blnReadOnly is true, all edit fields are disabled
If StudentRAITPros exists for a student, pre-fill fields
EnrollmentID > -1 triggers edit state for single record
Less than 14 rows hides Save All due to no scroll bars
system_behavior: Grid disables edit fields when read-only
Dynamic JavaScript is generated for dirty field tracking
UI adapts (shows/hides controls) based on edit mode and row count
Data binding applies filters, sorting, pagination
dependencies: HSPnetSession for user context and error handling
ObjectDataSource for RAIT and List data
exceptions: Operation is cancelled if user session is missing
Redirect prevented if errors exist in UserSession.Messages
Data binding cancelled if user session is null
content_gaps: No full UI markup or designer file details.
No external dependencies or API interfaces described.
No security or permissions rules beyond read-only state.
